overview: Alma counted 30,331 residents in the 2021 Census, down 1.4 percent from 30,771 in 2016. Its 13,815 occupied dwellings are spread over 194.92 square kilometres around the outlet of Lac Saint-Jean.

Rio Tinto's aluminium smelter anchors the economy, and Alma is the main shopping and service hub for Lac-Saint-Jean-Est. With a slightly shrinking population, a local business grows by winning customers from competitors and by drawing shoppers from surrounding municipalities, not by counting on new arrivals.

byService.lead-generation: Because Alma lost 1.4 percent of its population between 2016 and 2021, lead generation should reach beyond city limits to the rural Lac-Saint-Jean-Est municipalities that already shop there.
byService.seo: Alma SEO should target French searches naming the city and the wider Lac-Saint-Jean area, since many customers live outside the 194.92 square kilometre municipality but travel in for services.
byService.website-development: Visitors on the Véloroute des Bleuets and shift workers at the smelter both search on phones, so an Alma website needs quick mobile pages, directions and bilingual basics.
byService.branding: In a stable city of about 30,000 where Rio Tinto and long-time family firms set expectations, Alma branding should signal reliability and local roots more than novelty.
